rationale: The plan matches the reference closely: PyDESeq2 Wald test with apeglm shrinkage on ~condition with control as explicit reference, BH at 0.05 with independent filtering, median-of-ratios inside the model, and a minimal justified filter (10 counts in 6 samples). QC is thorough and specific to this dataset—library sizes, blind VST PCA, distance heatmap, library size vs PC1—with sample_01 retained by default and removal requiring a stated non-depth reason, plus a sensitivity refit. Enrichment uses gseapy prerank on the full list ranked by the Wald statistic, Hallmark with release to be stated, 15–500 window, fixed seed; the version is deferred to run time rather than named up front. The Python quasi-likelihood 'edgeR-style' second test is an unnecessary addition of uncertain fidelity, though the plan is honest about that risk; the report section is complete.
